title: OTP Properties: 6-Digit, Hashed, Single-Use, 10-Minute TTL
description: The auth module shall generate a single-use 6-digit OTP with a ten-minute expiry, storing only its hash.
rationale: Short TTL and single-use enforcement prevent replay attacks; storing only the hash ensures the OTP value cannot be recovered from a database compromise; 6 digits balance usability with the attempt-cap defense.
